description: This file defines the Endpoint class for handling oEmbed provider endpoints within Drupal's media module. It manages endpoint URLs, supported schemes, formats, and discovery support, and provides methods for URL matching and building resource URLs.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: Represents an oEmbed provider endpoint with URL, schemes, formats, and discovery support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Endpoint with URL, provider, schemes, formats, and discovery support, validating the URL.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the endpoint URL, with the format placeholder replaced by the first supported format or 'json' by default.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the provider object this endpoint belongs to.

methods.name: getSchemes
methods.description: Returns the list of URL schemes supported by the provider.

methods.name: getFormats
methods.description: Returns the list of supported formats.

methods.name: supportsDiscovery
methods.description: Indicates whether the provider supports oEmbed discovery.

methods.name: matchUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL matches any of the endpoint's schemes.

methods.name: buildResourceUrl
methods.description: Constructs the full resource URL for a given media URL.
